# ProReach

> ProReach is an approval-first AI marketing workspace for turning product context into coordinated social campaigns.

## What ProReach does

- Stores reusable product context: audience, positioning, proof, voice, goals, and constraints.
- Generates coordinated campaign drafts rather than disconnected one-off posts.
- Adapts campaign ideas for LinkedIn, Instagram, Threads, X, and Facebook.
- Supports review, editing, approval, scheduling, and publishing workflows.
- Keeps publishing under explicit human control.

## Intended users

ProReach is designed for founders, indie builders, lean marketing teams, and product marketers who want consistent multi-channel marketing without surrendering factual or creative control.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://proreach.in/
- Privacy: https://proreach.in/privacy
- Terms: https://proreach.in/terms

## Important clarification

ProReach assists with marketing creation and publishing workflows. It does not guarantee reach, engagement, search rankings, citations, leads, or revenue.
